job.title: Risk Assurance Advisor
job.description:

• Manage and enhance safety systems, policies and procedures
• Support incident management, compliance and assurance activities

About You

job.title: Health and Safety Business Partner
job.description:
Our client is seeking a highly experienced Health & Safety Business Partner to support the national operations of one of Australia's leading retail brands.

This is a highly visible business partnering role with a seat at the senior leadership table. This role is for a credible and commercially minded safety professional who enjoys working closely with senior leaders to support, advise and coach, while remaining connected to frontline operations.

You will work as an embedded member of the brand leadership team, partnering with General Managers to drive improved safety performance, strengthen leadership capability and deliver practical improvements across a large national store network.

While initially aligned to one brand, this role operates with a broader Group mindset and has enterprise level connections. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with Health and Safety Business Partners across other brands and contribute to Group wide initiatives, projects and improvements.

This is not a traditional safety advisor role. You will not be expected to do safety for the business. Instead, you will provide the advice, coaching, challenge and practical tools that enable operational leaders to own and deliver safety.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Partner with senior leaders to drive proactive safety outcomes
  • Provide trusted advice and practical support across operational teams
  • Translate safety strategy into practical, operational actions
  • Coach leaders to build safety capability, ownership and accountability
  • Challenge and influence leaders to strengthen safety performance and culture
  • Conduct store visits and partner with Regional and Area Managers
  • Identify risks, trends and opportunities for improvement
  • Build leadership capability through coaching and mentoring
Position Skills and Qualifications:
  • Formal qualifications in Health and Safety, WHS, OHS or similar
  • 5+ years' Health and Safety experience, ideally in a Business Partner or senior advisory role
  • Experience in complex, multi site or geographically dispersed operations
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and ability to influence senior leaders
  • Proven ability to coach, challenge and build leadership capability
  • Strong knowledge of safety culture and risk management
  • Confident, credible and comfortable respectfully pushing back when required
  • Autonomous, practical and commercially minded
  • Experience in retail or a similar large operational environment with large volumes of geographically dispersed sites is desirable
The Ideal Person:
You will be an experienced and credible safety professional who can comfortably move between the store floor and the senior leadership table.
You will have the confidence and experience to hold your own in robust conversations, challenge thinking when required and provide practical recommendations that leaders can understand and implement.

Importantly, you will enjoy coaching others rather than doing the work for them. You will understand how to build safety capability through operational leaders and know how to influence outcomes across a large and geographically dispersed business.

Join the Team:
This is an excellent opportunity to take on a genuine Health & Safety Business Partner role where you will have the autonomy, trust and visibility to make a real impact.

With a strong focus on lifting capability, strengthening consistency and supporting leaders to take ownership of safety, this role will suit someone who enjoys being operationally connected while also having a genuine seat at the table.

Apply Now:
To seize this exciting opportunity, submit your resume to jhottot@thesafestep.com.au

job.title: WHS Advisor

This is a hands-on, site-based role where you will:
  • Conduct WHS inspections across active projects and operational areas
  • Partner with contractors, project teams and operational stakeholders
  • Review risk assessments, SWMS and safety documentation
  • Support contractor safety performance and compliance
  • Conduct and support incident investigations

  • Confidence reviewing SWMS, risk assessments and safety documentation
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • The ability to work autonomously and effectively prioritise competing demands

  • Initial 6-month contract with strong potential for extension

  • Exposure to high-profile construction and infrastructure projects
  • Onsite parking provided

Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of HSEQ management systems
  • Facilitate risk management, incident investigations and corrective action processes
  • Support injury management and workers compensation activities

Contractor Management & Governance

While governance frameworks already exist, the organisation is looking to strengthen understanding and accountability around risk based contractor management, assurance planning and oversight, and leadership ownership of contractor performance and risk.

The business is progressing through a significant transformation journey, with increased emphasis on operational ownership of risk. You will help drive greater accountability within project teams and stronger contractor governance practices.

You will have the opportunity to influence major infrastructure delivery, strengthen contractor governance practices and help shape the future capability and culture of a business undergoing substantial transformation.
For an ambitious Health & Safety leader seeking genuine strategic impact, this represents one of the most compelling opportunities currently available in the market.
All enquiries and applications will be treated in strict confidence.

job.title: Head of Health, Safety & Environment
job.description:
A large, asset intensive industrial organisation with significant national importance is seeking an experienced Head of Health, Safety & Environment. Reporting directly to the CEO, this executive leadership opportunity will shape the future of health, safety and environmental performance across a complex, high hazard operation where process safety is fundamental to operational success.

This is not a traditional safety leadership role. We are seeking a senior HSE executive with deep experience in high hazard, process driven industrial environments who understands the realities of managing major hazards, critical risk controls and high consequence events.

The successful candidate will lead the next phase of a Safety Transformation Program while strengthening process safety capability, leadership accountability and operational risk management across the site.

What Success Looks Like
The key objective of this role is to deliver measurable improvements in process safety performance and organisational safety culture. Success will be measured by:
  • Strengthening process safety capability and operational discipline across the business
  • Improving the effectiveness and assurance of critical risk controls
  • Reducing high potential incidents and exposure to major hazards
  • Embedding process safety KPIs into business decision making and reporting
  • Increasing leadership ownership and accountability for risk management
  • Establishing the HSE function as a trusted and influential partner to operations
  • Driving sustained improvements in safety culture and leadership behaviours
The Opportunity
Leading a multidisciplinary HSE function, you will provide strategic leadership across health, safety, environment, emergency management, occupational health, governance and quality operations.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Leading the organisation's Safety Transformation Program
  • Strengthening process safety management frameworks, critical control verification and assurance systems
  • Driving improvement in high consequence risk management
  • Providing executive level advice on operational risk, process safety and safety performance
  • Embedding leading process safety indicators and performance measures
  • Coaching and developing leaders to strengthen ownership of safety and risk
  • Leading emergency preparedness, crisis management and organisational resilience initiatives
  • Ensuring regulatory compliance and environmental performance
  • Building capability across the HSE function and broader leadership team
About You
You are a recognised HSE leader with extensive experience within large scale, asset intensive and high hazard industrial operations. Most importantly, you have led process safety improvement within environments where failures can result in significant operational, environmental and human consequences.
You will bring:
  • Significant senior HSE leadership experience within high hazard industrial operations
  • Proven process safety leadership experience in asset intensive environments
  • Strong experience managing major hazards, critical risks and high consequence events
  • Expertise in critical control management, assurance and verification processes
  • Experience influencing operational leaders and strengthening accountability for risk
  • Relevant qualifications in engineering, safety, risk management or related disciplines
Experience within petrochemical, chemical manufacturing, fertiliser and explosives, energy, utilities, heavy industrial, metals or minerals processing environments will be highly regarded. Candidates from other comparable high hazard industries with strong process safety credentials are strongly encouraged to apply. 

For a confidential discussion, please contact Stephen Coldicutt at The Safe Step on scoldicutt@thesafestep.com.au

job.title: Head of Health, Safety & Environment
job.description:
A large, asset intensive industrial organisation with significant national importance is seeking an experienced Head of Health, Safety & Environment. Reporting directly to the CEO, this executive leadership opportunity will shape the future of health, safety and environmental performance across a complex, high hazard operation where process safety is fundamental to operational success.

This is not a traditional safety leadership role. We are seeking a senior HSE executive with deep experience in high hazard, process driven industrial environments who understands the realities of managing major hazards, critical risk controls and high consequence events.

The successful candidate will lead the next phase of a Safety Transformation Program while strengthening process safety capability, leadership accountability and operational risk management across the site.

What Success Looks Like
The key objective of this role is to deliver measurable improvements in process safety performance and organisational safety culture. Success will be measured by:
  • Strengthening process safety capability and operational discipline across the business
  • Improving the effectiveness and assurance of critical risk controls
  • Reducing high potential incidents and exposure to major hazards
  • Embedding process safety KPIs into business decision making and reporting
  • Increasing leadership ownership and accountability for risk management
  • Establishing the HSE function as a trusted and influential partner to operations
  • Driving sustained improvements in safety culture and leadership behaviours
The Opportunity
Leading a multidisciplinary HSE function, you will provide strategic leadership across health, safety, environment, emergency management, occupational health, governance and quality operations.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Leading the organisation's Safety Transformation Program
  • Strengthening process safety management frameworks, critical control verification and assurance systems
  • Driving improvement in high consequence risk management
  • Providing executive level advice on operational risk, process safety and safety performance
  • Embedding leading process safety indicators and performance measures
  • Coaching and developing leaders to strengthen ownership of safety and risk
  • Leading emergency preparedness, crisis management and organisational resilience initiatives
  • Ensuring regulatory compliance and environmental performance
  • Building capability across the HSE function and broader leadership team
About You
You are a recognised HSE leader with extensive experience within large scale, asset intensive and high hazard industrial operations. Most importantly, you have led process safety improvement within environments where failures can result in significant operational, environmental and human consequences.
You will bring:
  • Significant senior HSE leadership experience within high hazard industrial operations
  • Proven process safety leadership experience in asset intensive environments
  • Strong experience managing major hazards, critical risks and high consequence events
  • Expertise in critical control management, assurance and verification processes
  • Experience influencing operational leaders and strengthening accountability for risk
  • Relevant qualifications in engineering, safety, risk management or related disciplines
Experience within petrochemical, chemical manufacturing, fertiliser and explosives, energy, utilities, heavy industrial, metals or minerals processing environments will be highly regarded. Candidates from other comparable high hazard industries with strong process safety credentials are strongly encouraged to apply. 

For a confidential discussion, please contact Stephen Coldicutt at The Safe Step on scoldicutt@thesafestep.com.au

job.title: Director, Safety I VicGrid
job.description:
Join VicGrid and help shape the safety culture behind Victoria's next generation of energy infrastructure.

Location options: Melbourne or Regional Victoria

The Safe Step is proud to be partnering with VicGrid in seeking an accomplished Director, Safety to provide strategic and operational health and safety leadership across its Renewable Energy Zone (REZ) developments and broader portfolio of major energy infrastructure projects.

About VicGrid
VicGrid is a Victorian State Business Corporation responsible for planning Victoria’s transmission network and Renewable Energy Zones as the state transitions towards renewable energy. VicGrid is taking a coordinated approach to developing the transmission infrastructure Victoria needs to maintain a reliable and affordable electricity supply as ageing coal-fired generation retires.

The scale and complexity of VicGrid’s work is substantial.  Its current portfolio of projects will play an important role in reshaping Victoria's energy network and represent some of the state's most significant current and future infrastructure investment.

About the Opportunity
As Director, Safety and a member of the VicGrid Leadership Team, you will lead VicGrid's health and safety function and develop a high-performing Safety team, supporting the safe development and delivery of its programs. You will play a critical role in embedding safety into project planning and delivery while driving a positive, proactive and industry-leading safety culture.

You will lead the implementation of VicGrid's safety strategy, project risk and assurance activities and contractor safety frameworks, while providing trusted advice to Program Directors and senior leaders across the organisation.

Working across a complex stakeholder environment, you will have the opportunity to shape safety standards, behaviours and practices across VicGrid's project portfolio and the broader industry.

About you
You will be a highly experienced safety leader with a strong track record working across major infrastructure/construction, energy, utilities or similarly complex project environments.

You will combine deep technical safety expertise with the leadership presence and influencing capability required to operate effectively with executives, senior project leaders, contractors, regulators and government stakeholders.

Experience working within an active client model, with the ability to effectively influence delivery partners, provide appropriate governance and assurance, and navigate the balance between oversight and contractor accountability, is highly regarded.

You will bring:
  • A credible and pragmatic safety leadership approach, with strong executive presence balanced with humility, curiosity and authenticity.
  • The ability to connect with diverse teams and stakeholders, harness existing capability and bring people with you.
  • High levels of judgement, with the ability to prioritise and move comfortably between hands-on delivery, strategic thinking and senior-level influence.
  • Experience driving cultural change through safety initiatives and programs.
  • Strong leadership capability, with demonstrated experience developing high-performing teams.
  • The ability to provide strategic advice and constructive challenge at executive and senior project leadership level.
  • Strong project and risk management capability within complex, high-profile delivery environments.
  • The ability to lead and navigate significant organisational and industry change.
Why join VicGrid?
The 2025 Victorian Transmission Plan sets out a long-term, coordinated approach to the development of Victoria's energy infrastructure network. As VicGrid continues to lead planning, coordination and delivery across a significant portfolio of energy infrastructure initiatives, this role offers a unique opportunity to influence how major projects are safely developed and delivered across the state.

As Director, Safety, you will provide strategic leadership during a pivotal period for Victoria's energy transition, embedding a safety-first culture and establishing the frameworks, governance and capability that will support the successful delivery of VicGrid's objectives for years to come.

Your Contact
Cate Ingham

job.title: National Health and Safety Manager
job.description:
About the Organisation
Our client is a national industry leader operating a large and complex operational network across Australia. Supporting safety in the later stages of a critical industrial supply chain, the business oversees a diverse portfolio of asset intensive operations supporting the movement, transfer, processing and recovery of resources.
The operating environment encompasses logistics transfer facilities, fixed processing plants, heavy mobile equipment, transport operations, workshops, engineering activities and large scale civil works, creating a broad and complex risk profile. With a strong focus on operational excellence, risk management and continuous improvement, the organisation continues to invest in building a high performing safety culture across its national footprint.

About the Role
Reporting directly to the Head of Health and Safety, this leadership role will provide strategic and operational safety support across a nationally dispersed operational business. Leading a team of experienced Health and Safety professionals across multiple states, the role will focus on strengthening national alignment, embedding consistent standards and governance, and supporting operational leaders in managing critical risks across a complex, high risk operating environment.
The position will play a key role in supporting a new operating model designed to better connect regional and state based operations, while creating greater consistency in the way safety is managed across the business.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Leading, coaching and developing a geographically dispersed team of Health and Safety professionals
  • Driving consistency in safety standards, governance and assurance activities across the national operation
  • Partnering with senior operational leaders to support the effective management of critical operational risks
  • Building stronger alignment between state, regional and site leadership teams
  • Providing strategic guidance on risk management, assurance, investigations and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Influencing leaders at all levels to strengthen safety culture, accountability and operational ownership
  • Supporting the implementation of enterprise safety programs and key business transformation initiatives
  • Monitoring emerging risks, trends and performance indicators to drive proactive safety outcomes
About You
To be successful in this role, you will be an accomplished safety leader with experience operating in large, complex and high risk environments.
You will bring a strong operational mindset, exceptional stakeholder engagement capability and a demonstrated ability to lead teams through organisational change and transformation.
Your background will include:
  • Tertiary qualifications in Health and Safety or a related discipline
  • Significant leadership experience within civil engineering, transport, logistics, waste, heavy industry, infrastructure, mining, resources or similarly high risk sectors
  • Experience leading multi site or geographically dispersed Health and Safety teams
  • Strong understanding of critical risk management and operational assurance frameworks
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and coach senior operational leaders
  • Experience driving consistency, governance and standardisation across large operational portfolios
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage effectively from frontline teams through to executive leadership
  • Strong incident investigation, risk management and continuous improvement experience
  • A collaborative leadership style with the ability to build trusted relationships across diverse stakeholder groups
Why Apply?
This is a rare opportunity to play a key leadership role within one of Australia's largest operational environments.
You will have the opportunity to:
  • Shape and influence the future direction of a national Health and Safety function
  • Lead a highly experienced leadership team across a significant operational portfolio
  • Partner directly with senior and executive leaders
  • Drive meaningful improvement across a complex and high profile business
  • Join an organisation with a genuine commitment to safety, operational excellence and continuous improvement
